title: hellenia globosa
intro: Hellenia globosa, commonly known as Globe Daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Compositae. The Globe Daisy has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Globe Daisy include flavonoids, terpenes, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
